new_entities.name: Topical hyaluronic acid
new_entities.description: Topically applied hyaluronic acid-containing cosmetic or dermatologic formulations intended to improve skin hydration and visible skin quality.

new_entities.name: Acute skin hydration
new_entities.description: Short-term changes in measurable skin hydration, moisture retention, and related barrier-function markers after topical product application.

edges.effect_quant: In a randomized assessor-blinded forearm study, a single application of a 1% hyaluronic acid fluid increased skin hydration by 59% at 1 hour and still by 29% at 24 hours while lowering transepidermal water loss. Longer cosmetic trials and a later review point in the same direction, even if formulations differ.
edges.population: adult women using topical hyaluronic-acid-containing skin products for hours to weeks
edges.mechanism: Topical hyaluronic acid binds water in the stratum corneum and can temporarily improve surface hydration and barrier behaviour, especially when paired with humectants and barrier-supportive vehicles.
edges.summary: Topical hyaluronic acid is one of the cleaner hydration edges in cosmetic dermatology because the short-term signal is direct and reproducible: skin water content rises quickly after application. The limitation is that the effect is mainly supportive and cosmetic rather than a structural reversal of aging.
edges.caveats: Most studies test formulated products rather than hyaluronic acid alone, so vehicle effects matter. This edge is about acute hydration and barrier support, not permanent dermal remodeling.

evidence.citation: MilaniM et al 2017 Clin Cosmet Investig Dermatol
evidence.notes: The 24-hour skin hydration and barrier function effects of a hyaluronic 1%, glycerin 5%, and Centella asiatica stem cells extract moisturizing fluid: an intra-subject, randomized, assessor-blinded study.

effect_quant.comparator: increase in skin hydration 1 hour after application versus baseline

evidence.citation: NobileV et al 2014 J Cosmet Dermatol
evidence.notes: Anti-aging and filling efficacy of six types hyaluronic acid based dermo-cosmetic treatment: double blind, randomized clinical trial of efficacy and safety.
